correction: The DONE status is right, but two details are off. (1) Repo detection is no longer up to 3 rev-parse calls. Since #710 (60633eff3) it is a single combined `rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree --show-toplevel --git-common-dir` (GitVcsDriver.ts:493-520), and VcsDriverRegistry.ts:20 keeps positive detections for 2 min. The first sweep after a restart therefore costs at most 2 spawns per project (often about 1), not about 4P. (2) The auditor reported no fix defects. There is a small one: an empty `git worktree list` answer gets cached under a valid fingerprint (see fixDefects).
summary: Verified on main at ec250e386. The sweep no longer does 2P+1 whole shell snapshots. reconcileAllWorktrees reads listProjectShells once, then per project does one primary-key project read and one transaction with two indexed, column-narrow reads (getProjectWorkspaceRows). It passes those rows to both ensureProjectMainWorktree and the planner. The sweep starts 15 s after subscribeShell and runs its git in the background process lane. An in-memory registration fingerprint skips detection and `git worktree list` for unchanged repos, so a later sweep costs 0 git spawns. An architecture ratchet test bans new getShellSnapshot callers, and worktreeOperations.ts is not on its allow-list. Semantics match the old code: live non-deleted threads, live project worktrees, and a main row created mid-pass has a null path, which the planner ignores. One minor defect: an empty ("git could not answer") listing is cached and reused while the fingerprint stays the same.

evidence.note: reconcileAllWorktrees: 5-min throttle, Effect.sleep(RECONCILIATION_START_DELAY_MS=15s, line 74), readProjectShells (listProjectShells, no snapshot), concurrency 4, whole effect wrapped in inBackgroundProcessLane. The lane only affects child-process admission (processGovernor.ts:33-35, 109-124), so no permit is held during the sleep.

reconcileProjectWorktrees: getProjectShellById, then the fingerprint, then git only on a fingerprint miss, then getProjectWorkspaceRows once. rows.worktrees go to ensureProjectMainWorktree (no extra read) and the same rows feed planWorktreeReconciliation.

Defect: the tap caches `paths` even when it is [] (listWorktreePaths returns [] when the exit code is non-zero or detection says not-a-repo, GitVcsDriverCore.ts:3289-3305 and GitWorkflowService.ts:445-453). The planner treats [] as 'git could not answer' (worktreeReconciliation.ts:166-171).

Fingerprint = realpath(commonDir) + sorted worktrees/<name> + gitdir size and mtime. It returns null when <root>/.git is absent (subfolder projects, non-repos), so those always take the git path. When the worktrees dir is absent the value is `${commonDir}\0-`, so a .git dir that exists while git fails gets a stable non-null fingerprint.

listProjectWorktreeRows plus listProjectThreadWorkspaceRows (5 columns, project_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL) in one transaction. Index idx_projection_threads_project_deleted_created (migration 019) and idx_projection_worktrees_project_archived (migration 030). Same thread set as the old snapshot filter deletedAt === null.
Detection is one combined rev-parse since 60633eff3, not three. VcsDriverRegistry.ts:13-20 sets a 2-min positive and 2-s negative detection TTL.
Exact-count ratchet over getShellSnapshot callers. ws/context/worktreeOperations.ts is not allowed, so reintroducing a snapshot read here fails the test.

Tests cover: one project's rows instead of snapshots; git skipped while registrations are unchanged and re-run after a new worktrees/<name>/gitdir; 15 s delay via TestClock; background lane; chat and missing roots skipped. There is no test for an empty listing.
subscribeShell still forkDetaches reconcileAllWorktrees. Because of the delay and the narrow reads, it no longer competes with the shell snapshot that the subscription loads.

remaining: Nothing required. Optional residuals, all low value: (a) knownWorktreeListings (worktreeOperations.ts:91-94) is in-memory. The first sweep after each restart still spawns up to 2 git processes per repo (combined rev-parse unless detection is cached, plus `git worktree list`), 15 s after the first subscribe and in the background lane. (b) reconcileProjectWorktrees re-reads each project via getProjectShellById (line 736) although the sweep already holds the shells from line 919: P cheap PK reads. (c) Projects whose root has no own .git (monorepo subfolders) never get a fingerprint and run git on every sweep. A non-repo project with no main row also costs 1 detection spawn per sweep via localStatus (line 306). (d) knownWorktreeListings never evicts deleted projects. The memory is trivial. (e) The sweep is still triggered by subscribeShell rather than a startup phase. For load the effect is the same.
fixDefects: Minor: worktreeOperations.ts:749-760 caches an empty `git worktree list` answer whenever the fingerprint is non-null. That happens when <root>/.git exists but git exits non-zero or detection returns null. Examples: 'detected dubious ownership' before the user fixes safe.directory, or a .git dir that is partial or corrupt during a clone. The planner treats [] as 'git could not answer' and plans nothing. With no worktree churn, the fingerprint (`${commonDir}\0-`) stays the same after the repo becomes healthy, so reconciliation for that project stays a silent no-op until the server restarts or a worktree is added or removed. Before the fix it was retried every sweep. Timeouts and spawn errors fail the effect and are not cached, so only non-zero-exit and not-a-repo answers are affected. Nothing is corrupted (an empty plan does nothing), but the self-healing is lost.
implementationSketch: 1) Fix the defect (S). In reconcileProjectWorktrees (worktreeOperations.ts:750-759), store the entry only when `fingerprint !== null && paths.length > 0`, otherwise delete it. A real repository always lists at least its own root, so [] is never a trustworthy answer. Add a test in worktreeOperations.test.ts next to 'skips git worktree list while a repository's registrations are unchanged': run `git init` on a temp dir, make the listWorktreePaths stub return [] the first time and [root] the second, and assert git is called on both runs. 2) Optional (S): let reconcileProjectWorktrees take the OrchestrationProjectShell from the sweep's listProjectShells result (keep a projectId overload for other callers) to drop P getProjectShellById reads. 3) Optional (S): remove knownWorktreeListings entries for project ids missing from the current project list in reconcileAllWorktrees, next to the missingProjectRoots cleanup. 4) Optional (M, low value): persist {projectId, root, fingerprint, paths} (a small projection table or a JSON file under the server state dir) so the first post-restart sweep is also spawn-free. Load it lazily in the sweep and keep the same validation (root equality plus fingerprint match, and never persist []).
decisionReason: Server-local caching and read-path change. No auth, E2EE, hosted lifecycle, Hub protocol or product trade-off is involved.
